BG_KOAKUMA_SECONDARY_RESOURCE_MAGIC.desc: Some cards spend [orange]Magic[/orange] to trigger bonus effects. If you do not have enough [orange]Magic[/orange], the card can still be played, but the bonus effect will not trigger.
BG_KOAKUMA_MAGIC_COST.title: Magic Cost
BG_KOAKUMA_MAGIC_COST.description: Spend that much [orange]Magic[/orange] to trigger the effect after the colon.
BG_KOAKUMA_TIP_BLOCK.title: Block
BG_KOAKUMA_TIP_BLOCK.description:
[gold]Block[/gold] prevents attack damage.
Lose all [gold]Block[/gold] at end of turn.
BG_KOAKUMA_TIP_READ.title: Read
BG_KOAKUMA_TIP_READ.description:
Look at up to 3 cards from the top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], choose 1 to put into your [gold]Hand[/gold], then put 1 card from your [gold]Hand[/gold] on the bottom of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
When easy read settings are enabled, the look and return steps are handled automatically.
BG_KOAKUMA_TIP_INTERPRET.title: Interpret
BG_KOAKUMA_TIP_INTERPRET.description: An [purple]Interpreted[/purple] card gains a one-time interaction defined by that card or another effect. It loses [purple]Interpreted[/purple] status after leaving your [gold]Hand[/gold].
BG_KOAKUMA_TIP_MAGIC_BOOK_COLLECTION.des:
Choose cards from your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold] and remove them from combat to discover or generate [gold]Magic Book[/gold] cards. If there are no choices, create a Mysterious Magic Book.
When easy [gold]Magic Book Collection[/gold] is enabled, it automatically removes 1 random card from the lowest rarity group and shuffles 1 random [gold]Magic Book[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
BG_KOAKUMA_TIP_MAGIC_BURN.title: Magic Burn
BG_KOAKUMA_TIP_MAGIC_BURN.description: Koakuma's burning debuff. Related cards and powers trigger extra effects based on [red]Magic Burn[/red] stacks.
